subject: MSA redline sync + onboarding sandbox demo — schedule squeeze
messages:
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@cardinalhealthtech.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodai.com, monica.patel@redwoodai.com
Cc: procurement@cardinalhealthtech.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline + onboarding demo availability

Hi Rafael / Monica,

Thanks for sending the redline earlier. Legal reviewed and has a couple of narrow asks around data residency and audit access that they'd like to talk through before we kick off the sandbox demo. Our team is pretty slammed next week (Q2 close), so availability is limited.

Can we aim for a 30–45 minute sync on Thursday 5/20 (late morning PT) or Friday 5/21 (early afternoon PT)? If those don't work, we'll need to push to the week of 5/24. Also could you attach the version of the MSA with change-tracking on? That helps speed our review.

Avery Collins
Senior Counsel, Cardinal Healthtech
avery.collins@cardinalhealthtech.com

Attachment: none (they referenced the redline we received)
From: rafael.mendes@redwoodai.com <rafael.mendes@redwoodai.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@cardinalhealthtech.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodai.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 13:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline + onboarding demo availability

Hi Avery — appreciate the heads up.

We're happy to prioritize the legal touchpoints. I attached Cardinal_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (changes highlighted) and a short onboarding checklist so your team can see what we'll cover in the sandbox demo.

Thursday 5/20 11:30–12:15 PT or Friday 5/21 13:00–13:45 PT both work for us. If you need a slightly longer slot (45 min) on Friday we can expand.

Quick notes:
- If legal wants to confirm audit-log retention and KMS key control, Monica (cc'd) can walk through our Private deployment options and evidence sources during the call.
- For the sandbox demo we'll provision a temporary VPC endpoint and a sample dataset; that takes ~48 hours to set up once you confirm the slot.

Attachments: Cardinal_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (3 pages), redwood-onboard-checklist.md (1 page)

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodai.com | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the attachments. 

Avery, quick update from our legal/compliance side: their lead has a conflicting board prep on Thursday 5/20 AM and we just got confirmation they'll only be available for a narrow window on Friday 5/21 at 14:00–14:45 PT. That's our best shot before the 5/24 runway.

If Friday 14:00 PT works for you we'll:
- Lock the 45-minute slot and expand to 60 if more time is needed.
- Kick off sandbox provisioning immediately after your confirmation (48 hour lead).
- Share a short evidence bundle during the call (SOC 2 scope, KMS diagram, audit log excerpt).

One ask: can you confirm which regions you expect to run inference in for the evaluation (us-west-2 / us-east-1 / eu-west-1)? That affects the audit/log examples we pull.

Monica Patel

- 5 min introductions / scope recap
